summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Short COIN Daily ETF (CONI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund provides 2x inverse exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Coinbase Global, Inc. stock. CONI was launched on Sep 3, 2024 and is issued by GraniteShares.
